description: Bluetooth Travel Sensors -Traffic Match Summary Records (TMSR) is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. View the Complete Dataset documentation on Github: This dataset contains aggregate travel time and speed summaries based on the individual traffic match records from the City of Austin's Bluetooth travel sensors.. Each row in the dataset summarizes average travel time and speed along a sensor-equipped roadway segment in 15 minute intervals. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are transit, traffic, mobility, bluetooth, travel time. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2021-12-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
